summary: The note describes the end of UConn Huskies women's basketball's 2016-era season run as told in a short Wikipedia-style passage. UConn entered the NCAA tournament unbeaten, ranked #1 overall and a heavy favorite, after easy wins in its conference regular season and conference tournament. Its season ended when Mississippi State's Morgan William hit a buzzer-beater for a 66-64 overtime win in the NCAA Final Four, ending a 111-game winning streak that the note calls an all-time record.
one_line: UConn women's basketball's unbeaten 111-game streak ended in a 2016 NCAA Final Four overtime loss to Mississippi State.
key_facts: UConn entered the NCAA tournament unbeaten after easy wins in both its conference regular season and its conference tournament.
UConn entered the NCAA tournament ranked # 1 overall.
UConn was once again a heavy favorite to win the NCAA championship.
UConn's season ended in the NCAA Final Four.
Mississippi State's Morgan William hit a buzzer-beater to give Mississippi State a 66 - 64 overtime victory over UConn.
The loss ended UConn's streak at 111 consecutive wins.
The 111-game winning streak was an all-time record for college basketball games.
The 111-game winning streak was also an all-time record for any team sport played at the college level.
